import PortalLanding from "../../../components/PortalLanding.astro";

To build an AI employee, define its role and use the [employee builder](/build/builder/) to create and validate its package. Publish the package as a template that others can install in a workspace. For help installing a published template, see [Agents and AI employees](/user-guide/ai-employees/).

Open **FDE workbench** (FDE 工作台) in the console header. The route is `/fde/`. A signed-in user who is neither an FDE user nor an administrator sees a permission notice. **Channel configuration** (渠道配置) and **Agent tests** (Agent 评估) appear only for administrators.

## Choose the work

<PortalLanding portal="build" section="paths" />

Customer discovery records interviews and meetings. It does not confirm a role, a fact, or an acceptance criterion. Those still need a person who owns the domain.
